'''May 2001 Minneapolis tournament (26 May)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Outpost 2000 and Beyond, Minneapolis, Minnesota on 26 May 2001. [[Michael Raveling]] won it. It is known from Michael Raveling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2385">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-27-minneapolis-mn-2001d2385/ minneapolis-mn-2001], DeckTech (Michael "Gilliatt" Raveling, 27 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-27-minneapolis-mn-2001d2385/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 26 May 2001
* '''Site:''' Outpost 2000 and Beyond, Minneapolis, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Raveling]]
